item.title: Ersnikos #3183 the Twice-Born of the House of Chthonius fell (the stone in their midst (Ho
item.description: Ersnikos #3183 the Twice-Born of the House of Chthonius fell (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Ersnikos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Ersnikos #3183 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Ersnikos #3183 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Ersnikos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
